title: Finding
description: A security finding about the agent environment. Every finding carries evidence: a claim without evidence is an opinion, and it will be triaged as noise once and ignored forever.

ruleId.description: Stable catalogue ID. One ID means exactly one semantic issue and IDs are NEVER recycled — a retired check keeps its ID marked deprecated. See docs/findings/catalog.yaml.

confidence.description: Three bands only. A percentage would be fake precision — the underlying analysis does not support it.

evidence.description: What was actually observed. MUST NOT contain secret values — record that a credential exists and where, never its material.

source.description: Path or origin. Redacted where it would leak private information.

path.description: The relationship path that makes this reachable, ordered from origin to target. This is what turns a fact into a blast radius.

via.description: The relationship or capability traversed, e.g. sts:AssumeRole.

remediation.description: The action that closes this. A finding without one is a statistic.

assumptions.description: What the analysis could not resolve — e.g. conditional IAM that could not be fully evaluated. Stating this is what makes the confidence band meaningful.
